title: cocode.ran (event)
description: The window ran the build on this machine through the engine's local runner (POST /lip/run, after the human's consent) and the run is over; the output is already in the Output pane. React with one line. When it failed, offer the fix as a ghost or an annotation and send a corrected cocode.build; never run it again yourself. Sent instead of cocode.run, never with it.

run.description: The window's id for this run: r_<rev>_<n>.

rev.description: The editor's rev when Run was pressed.

buildRev.description: The rev of the build that ran; lower than rev when the build was stale.

lang.description: The runner's language name: python, javascript or typescript.

sandbox.description: The isolation level the runner used: audit-hook (python) or node-permission (javascript, typescript).

exit.description: Exit code; null when the runner killed the process.

timedOut.description: true when the time limit (30 s by default) killed it.

killed.description: Why the runner killed it: its time limit or its 1 MB output cap; null when it exited by itself.

stdout.description: The last 4 000 characters, with a leading … when cut.

stderr.description: The last 4 000 characters, with a leading … when cut.

rev.description: Document revision; starts at 1 and never goes down.
